budget_items.what_was_recorded: Town Counsel said the agreement states the Town pays nothing unless it receives the credits on the utility invoice.

budget_items.topic: Sale of net metering credits to other municipalities

budget_items.quote: the town could then sell these credits to another municipality that uses the same utility in the same load zone.
